body:
GREG DIRECT, 2026-11-04 about 06:23Z, relayed verbatim by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #205, message 5800b557): „Moim zdaniem tracicie czas. Nie wiem co ma to dać. Testy na czas nigdy nie sa wiarygodne i stabilne.” Asistant's brief: don't spend capacity on costly test repeats only for wall-clock thresholds; focus on deterministic behaviour tests and the main EO/task sync queue, keeping real requirements and regression protection; confirm what stops and what continues.
So: no more margin measurements or reruns for time thresholds, no review rounds for them. A test that fails on elapsed time gets a deterministic replacement (counted work, injected clock, event order), not a repeat or a tuned threshold. New tests don't assert wall-clock upper bounds unless a real product limit requires it, stated beside it. Confirmed to Greg 06:24Z.
